body:
This is the energetic upgrade your Frequency Generator has been waiting for. The Copper Conductor Bundle was intentionally designed to amplify, refine, and elevate the energy your device emits—creating a stronger, clearer, and more stabilized output that your body and space can fully receive.

Copper is one of the most conductive materials on Earth, used for centuries in energy healing, architecture, and even ancient temples. Its natural ability to move, direct, and enhance energy makes it the perfect partner for your scalar frequency device. Heather describes this setup as building a dome of frequency—and once activated, this dome creates a contained yet expansive field that not only holds your intention, but amplifies it.

This bundle includes three core elements:

  • Copper Plate (Base): Place it underneath your generator to stabilize and ground the scalar frequency while increasing energetic flow from the bottom up.
  • Copper Pyramid (Top): Align it directly above the generator to channel and direct energy upward, enhancing broadcast range and precision.
  • 4 Copper Activation Spheres: Position them at the four corners of your generator to complete the energetic dome, sealing in your field and maximizing resonance.

When used together, these copper tools transform your generator into a broadcasting powerhouse—perfect for manifestation grids, energy healing setups, meditation spaces, or anywhere you want amplified energetic support.

Whether you’re working with 7.83Hz for grounding, 528Hz for cellular repair, 963Hz for pineal activation, or any other frequency in the lineup—this copper configuration ensures that the transmission is clean, strong, and sacred.
